notes: The first paid run: every corpus task, 3 repetitions, one arm, no verdict. The report prints each task's pass rate over its repetitions (with a note on tasks at 0 of 3 or 3 of 3, which carry no information), the price per attempt and how attempts ended, so pass rates and prices are measured before anyone writes more tasks or sizes a campaign. maxSpendUsd is the owner's to set: a live run is held to the lower of it and --max-spend-usd. Expected attempts: corpus tasks × 3.
